```{r}
#| label: map-data
#| include: false

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(htmltools)
  library(jsonlite)
})

source("R/data_helpers.R")

char <- load_characteristic_data()

map_rows <- char |>
  transmute(
    country = trimws(.data$Country),
    region = trimws(.data$Region),
    who_region = trimws(.data$`WHO Region`),
    reporting = trimws(.data$`Reporting vivax cases (<5 years)`),
    cases_2023 = trimws(.data$`2023 Case Numbers`),
    first_line = trimws(.data$`Pv 1st line treatment`),
    second_line = trimws(.data$`Pv 2nd line treatment`),
    g6pd_guidelines = trimws(.data$`Guidelines G6PD testing  (Y/N)`),
    g6pd_implementation = trimws(.data$`Implementation: G6PD testing  (Y/N)`),
    g6pd_type = trimws(.data$`Type of G6PD testing`),
    program_phase = trimws(.data$`Program Phase`)
  ) |>
  filter(nzchar(.data$country))

map_payload <- list(
  countries = map_rows,
  regions = sort(unique(map_rows$region[nzchar(map_rows$region)]))
)

map_json <- jsonlite::toJSON(
  map_payload,
  dataframe = "rows",
  auto_unbox = TRUE,
  na = "null",
  null = "null"
)

map_json <- gsub("</", "<\\/", map_json, fixed = TRUE)
```

::: {.map-intro}
Use the controls to change what the map shows. Hover over a country for a quick
summary, or select it to keep its details open.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="policy-map-shell">
  <aside class="policy-map-controls" aria-label="Map controls">
    <div class="policy-map-control">
      <label for="policy-map-metric">Colour countries by</label>
      <select id="policy-map-metric">
        <option value="g6pd_guidelines">G6PD testing in guidelines</option>
        <option value="g6pd_implementation">G6PD testing implemented</option>
        <option value="first_line">First-line treatment</option>
        <option value="program_phase">Programme phase</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    <div class="policy-map-control">
      <label for="policy-map-region">Region</label>
      <select id="policy-map-region">
        <option value="">All regions</option>
      </select>
    </div>

    <button id="policy-map-reset" class="policy-map-reset" type="button">Reset view</button>

    <div id="policy-map-legend" class="policy-map-legend" aria-label="Map legend"></div>
    <p class="policy-map-note">Countries outside the repository are shown in grey.</p>
  </aside>

  <div class="policy-map-stage">
    <div id="policy-map-status" class="policy-map-status" role="status">Loading country boundaries…</div>
    <svg id="policy-map" class="policy-map" role="img" aria-label="Interactive world map of P. vivax policies"></svg>
    <div id="policy-map-tooltip" class="policy-map-tooltip" role="tooltip" hidden></div>
  </div>

  <aside id="policy-map-details" class="policy-map-details" aria-live="polite">
    <div class="policy-map-details__empty">
      <span class="policy-map-details__eyebrow">Country details</span>
      <h2>Select a country</h2>
      <p>Choose a coloured country on the map to keep its policy summary here.</p>
    </div>
  </aside>
</div>
```

```{r}
#| label: map-json
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

cat(as.character(tags$script(
  id = "policy-map-data",
  type = "application/json",
  HTML(map_json)
)))
```
